sources.title: qda-lab/QDA-Qwen3.5-9B-W4A8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: QDA Qwen3.5-9B W4A8 W4A8 checkpoint of Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B found by a QDA search ("QDA: Closed-Loop Quantization Design with LLM Agents", MLSys 2027 submission). compressed-tensors format; loads in vLLM as is. These are the exact files the paper evaluated (search r-9995ede2, hand-in h8).

sources.title: RedHatAI/Qwen3.5-9B-quantized.w4a16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model was evaluated on GSM8k-Platinum, MMLU-Pro, IFEval, Math 500, AIME 2025, and GPQA Diamond using lm-evaluation-harness and lighteval, with inference served via vLLM.
